requirements.statement: Bind entry to PR 12 head, squash commit, tree, parent, exact-head CI, immutable artifact, artifact digests, and post-merge main CI.
Byte-verify protected Stage 3 authorities and preserve every accepted v1 and v2 schema.
Expose immutable current-bundle observations including identical replays while retaining the existing new-business-effect record view.
Reconcile replay observations and immutable prior transaction state without applying any source identity twice.
Use exactly processor, merchant_id, payment_id, event_class, and currency as the transaction grain.
Evaluate the full outer union of processor-event and transaction-journal keys and keep missing sources explicit.
Apply policy event signs and aggregate every unique processor event exactly once with checked signed 64-bit arithmetic.
Calculate ledger movement from PROCESSOR_CLEARING debits minus credits and never substitute total journal debits.
Treat invalid clearing count, posting side, or policy-disallowed counterpart role as INVALID_ACCOUNT_ROLE.
Reject processor, ledger, delta, difference, count, and reference-capacity overflow before publishing candidates.
Resolve every negative event to an exact capture source identity in the same processor, merchant, payment, and currency scope.
Forbid negative reference chains and preserve unresolved references as UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE.
Aggregate refund, chargeback, and reversal application against one exact capture before evaluating capacity.
Keep multiple captures for one payment as distinct capacity pools and make capacity independent of input order.
Emit deterministic financial reasons for missing evidence, invalid roles, unresolved references, over-application, and processor-ledger mismatch.
Apply tolerance only after complete semantically valid evidence; semantic reasons always force EXCEPTION.
Produce exact transaction totals, counts, signed delta, absolute difference, status, and ordered reason codes.
Return immutable transaction candidates and state with canonical deterministic digests and no partial transition after rejection.
Bind transaction batch identity to run, policy, manifest, source state, and candidate values while excluding time and arrival order.
Keep production independent from the reference oracle, settlement calculation, bank allocation, persistence, proof finalization, Spark, network, and AWS.
Expose a read-only local command whose success and rejection outputs never claim an authoritative proof.
Pass the full suite, 100 percent Stage 4 statement and branch coverage, semantic mutations, wheel installation, and two clean Python 3.11.13 runs.
Require exact-head draft-PR CI, immutable evidence inspection, squash merge, and independent main CI before Stage 4 promotion.
